pages.text: Winter forest birds had nothing to eat. Grandpa hung a little wooden box by the window, a feeder for birds.
Nils hoped a great tit would visit. He wanted to watch it peck right by the window.
Grandpa put down only a handful of seeds. Nils lifted the whole sack. "I'll give them all the food!"
He poured seeds in a heap. They overflowed the feeder and fell onto snow.
Nils waited by the window. Until sunset, no great tit came.
Night came. Big snowflakes poured outside. From bed, Nils watched the window.
Morning. Snow covered the feeder. No seeds, no great tit to see.
Grandpa swept off snow and added just a handful. "One handful is plenty. More tomorrow."
The next morning too, Nils added only a handful. The feeder had no time to pile up with snow.
Flutter! A great tit landed. Peck, peck, peck. Behind the glass, Nils held his breath.
